definitions.energy_saving_pct: -100 * (energy_wf - energy_noop) / energy_noop, all gNBs, J per simulated s in the KPI window
definitions.hot_prb_reduction_pct: -100 * (PRB_wf - PRB_noop) / PRB_noop summed over the policy's source cells (shed.from); no source cell or noop sum 0 -> undefined -> reject
definitions.remaining_prb_increase_pct: 100 * (PRB_wf - PRB_noop) / PRB_noop summed over the gNBs this instance did not switch off (its own OFF commands); noop sum 0 -> 0 if wf sum is 0 else +inf
definitions.verdict: accept iff every criterion of the workflow holds; twin verdict from predicted (twin) deltas, live outcome from measured (live) deltas, same thresholds

kpi_source.dl_buffer_kbytes: du-cell-<c>.txt: sum of DRB.BufferSize.Qos.UEID over UEs, same writes
kpi_source.dl_delay_ms: DlPdcpStats.txt: PDCP DL delay, mean weighted by nRxPDUs over the same epochs
kpi_source.dl_throughput_mbps: DlPdcpStats.txt (ns-3 PDCP stats at the LTE anchor, 0.25 s epochs): RxBytes received by all UEs in the epochs inside [t0, t1], i.e. UE-received DL goodput incl. UEs left without service
kpi_source.e2_kpm: kpi_e2 / kpi_per_cell_e2: the same window from the E2 KPM stream (pre-2026-10-28 KPI source), reported in summary_e2kpm.*
kpi_source.prb_used_dl: full-period PRB per 100 ms period (k*100, (k+1)*100] ms rebuilt from the two consumers of ns-3's shared DU calculator: the E2 report at k*100+phi ms (window phi, kpm.csv) and the DU logger write at (k+1)*100 ms (window 100-phi, du-cell-<c>.txt), weighted phi/100 and (100-phi)/100; sum of RRU.PrbUsedDl.UEID over UEs, mean over the periods inside (t0, t1] (a cell with no UE = 0). Runs without sim-time KPM stamps (pre-fix): DU logger alone
